content: flutter_gapless_loop (0.0.12) provides sample-accurate looping with zero gap/click at boundaries for iOS/Android/macOS/Windows/Linux. Built-in MetronomePlayer supports configurable BPM and 1-16 beat time signatures with beat stream for UI sync. flutter_soloud (4.1.7) offers low-latency playback via SoLoud C++ engine with playClocked (sub-millisecond accuracy) for 3D audio/games. For 4/4 metronome, flutter_gapless_loop is purpose-built; flutter_soloud is general-purpose overkill.
